willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Hello there. What are you doing all the way out here?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: No... I found something. A door.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: A door? I see doors all the time. What makes this one so special?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: It's buried beneath a tonne of rocks. Could be the entrance to some ancient ruins...

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Wow! Ancient ruins? Are you an archaeologist or something?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Of course I am! I'm the greatest archaeologist of our time. The name's Willow! Have you not heard of me?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: I'm afraid I haven't. Are you looking for a way into the ruins?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: You bet I am, but I don't think there's any other way in.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.player: Oh dear. Do you have another plan to get in?

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Potentially, but I won't be able to do it on my own. Nor can I leave the area. If I'm not here to guard the entrance, some other archaeologist might come along and steal the glory from me!

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Maybe you could give me a hand? There could be untold riches inside the ruins!

steps.player: A chance to uncover ancient ruins doesn't happen every day! Of course I'll help! I'm [player name] by the way. How do you plan to get in?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: The entrance is covered in rocks and rubble - I don't think mining them will work.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We'll need something stronger. Who knows what could be inside the ruins. There could be traps, or even monsters!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: No, I think we'll need to get my old crew...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: ...I mean, excavation team together. But you'll need to convince them to help us. We didn't part on the best of terms.

steps.player: What happened?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We had a falling out after a, uhm... dig, went wrong.

steps.player: Where can I find your old team, and how will they help?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: To get into the ruins we'll need to blow up all the rocks blocking the entrance.

steps.player: That doesn't sound too safe. What if we damage the ruins? Surely it's better to go slower and preserve as much as we can?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: No! We need to get in there as soon as possible! Burntof the dwarf will do it. He's a master with explosives.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: From what I can remember, he's a fan of his drink. His favourite pub being the Rising Sun Inn, in Falador - I'd look there first.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: After we've blown the rocks away, we'll need someone to move all the rubble. Someone strong.

steps.player: I could do it! I'm quite strong myself.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Ha ha ha! I don't think so. We need a real [strongman/strongwoman] - someone with muscles. An old friend of mine, Checkal, should be able to do all the heavy lifting.

steps.player: Oh okay... Where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hmm... We had quite a rough falling out when we last spoke, but I heard he's hanging around Barbarian Village.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Lastly, if my hunch is correct, this place will be covered in traps. We'll need my pal Marley to disarm them. He's the best thief I know. Been doing it for years.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I have no idea where he is these days. But his cousin Charlie in Varrock may know. You should talk to him. He's normally somewhere near the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.player: You have a rather interesting group of friends... but if they get us into the ruins, I'm all for it.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Good luck. Once you've recruited one of the team, I'll meet them at the entrance. It's on the west side of the mountain.

steps.player: Seems like you're in a bit of a pickle. Have fun with that.

willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.speaker: Willow
willow-the-archaeologist-talking-to-will.text: Back again? What can I help you with?

steps.player: Where can I find Marley?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Marley is an elusive one, to be honest. I have no idea where to find him. You should try talk to his cousin Charlie near the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. Maybe he will know.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

steps.player: Where can I find Checkal?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Last I heard Checkal was hanging around Barbarian Village. Maybe you should head there to find him?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

steps.player: Where can I find Burntof?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Burntof likes to hang out at the Rising Sun Inn located in Falador.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Need help finding anyone else?

options.text: Where can I find the entrance to the ruins?

steps.player: Where can I find the entrance to the ruins?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: On the western side of Ice Mountain. There's no way up on this side so you'll need to head east of here first and go around the dwarf colony to get there.

steps.player: Okay.
Nothing, thanks.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hurry up! It's not exactly exciting standing out here all day.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Hello there. I'm [player name] and I'm looking for a man named Checkal.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: That would be me [sir/miss]. What can I do for you?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: I was told to come find you. Willow has found a new digsi...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Stop right there [sir/miss]. You can tell Willow she can do the heavy lifting herself.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Willow does not appreciate the amount of work that goes into building my physique. I would not help her lift a shrimp.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I take great pride in these muscles and it hurts me to the core to hear such insults!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: But we need your help! She's found a new archaeological digsite and needs you to help clear the entrance.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Archaeological digsite? Why is Willow interested in starting a digsite?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: She said there could be some ancient ruins, even an untouched hoard of gold and treasure!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Ah that makes sense. *Sighs* You poor [lad/lass]...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Nothing. Look, I will help you. But first you must prove your strength to me.
If the player has 99 Strength:

steps.player: Well Checkal, I don't mean to brag, but there are few people in Gielinor stronger than me.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Hmm... I will see about that.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Yes... you do have tremendous muscle mass.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Your legs are strong as steel, too.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Well [player name], I have to say you are the definition of strength.

steps.player: I do try.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: But a [strongman/strongwoman] doesn't stop when they reach the top. They always push themselves.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If the player doesn't have 99 Strength:

steps.player: Well that shouldn't be too hard. I'm pretty strong.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: That is true. But are you strong in both body and mind?

steps.player: Uhm... yes?

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: To be a true [strongman/strongwoman], you do not just need big muscles. No, you must have self control and an unrelenting desire to push yourself to become stronger.

steps.player: Oh, I'm not sure about that...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I would ask you to train with my old friend and trainer, Atlas, one of the strongest barbarians I know. You can find him in the hall north of here.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If you can survive his rigorous training program, I shall offer you my help.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: How do you know he'll train me?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Tell him I sent you and he will train you.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Alright then, I'll go speak to Atlas. Farewell.
I seem to have forgotten where Atlas is. Can you remind me?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Atlas can be found in the hall to the north of us.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: No problem at all.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: I've just come to talk to you. Checkal said you could train me. He said you're the strongest barbarian he knows.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: Oh did he now? What makes you think I will train you?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: Come on then! Out with it already!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Well uh, he said he wouldn't...

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: I'm just pulling your leg! Any friend of Checkal is a friend of mine.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Please don't scare me like that.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: It's a force of habit. It comes with the barbarian lifestyle. But to apologise, I'll give you a free lesson!

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.player: Oh really? How much would this usually cost?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas.text: No price is too much for a good workout. Are you ready to start your training session?

steps.text: Training session begins.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: If you want to become a [strongman/strongwoman], you need to get into shape!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: It's not all about strength! You need to get some cardio in, too.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: You need to be tough to be a [strongman/strongwoman]! Show me what you've got! Come on!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Every [strongman/strongwoman] was once a beginner who refused to give up.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: You need to push yourself!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Always strive to be the best that you can be! That is the [strongman/strongwoman] way.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: I'm very proud of you. You've shown grit, determination and an iron will. You are a true [strongman/strongwoman] at heart.

steps.player: That was exhausting... I've never worked so hard in my life!

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: And for that, I am proud. Now, show us what you're made of and flex those muscles!
You have unlocked the flex emote!
Training session ends.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: My work is done. Return to Checkal and show him your new-found muscles.

steps.player: Not right now, I am a bit busy.

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: No problem. Come back when you are ready.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You're back. Would you like to start that training session now?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: Well done, little one. You've proven your worth.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.player: It was fun, I'd like to do it again.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You're the first person to ask me that [player name]. I suppose I could train you again, but I will have to charge you the full 25,000 coins this time.

steps.player: Let's do this, I'm ready.

steps.text: If the player has 25000 coins on them:

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: It's not going to be any easier my friend!
Training session restarts. See above for dialogue.
If the player doesn't have 25000 coins on them:

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: Hold it there little one, you don't have enough money to pay for the lesson.

steps.player: Oh, sorry I was too excited...

steps.speaker: Atlas
steps.text: No worries friend, come back when you can afford the session.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.player: Thanks for that workout. I can see why you normally charge people so much.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: Back again I see, here for another workout?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-atlas-a.text: You must take your training very seriously [player name]. This is the second time you'll have done this workout and paid full price!
Pay Atlas 25,000 coins to train again?

checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.text: Back again I see, here for another workout?

checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.speaker: Atlas
checkal-the-strongman-subsequent-trainin.text: You take your training very seriously [player name]. You know you've done this workout [times done] times, are you sure you want to do it again?
Pay Atlas 25,000 coins to train again?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: So have you completed your training session with Atlas?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Just about, but it was a real struggle.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: It always is, but I can see you are standing taller and looking stronger already.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Now, show me your muscles and I will judge if you're ready to receive my help.
Show your strength by flexing your muscles.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: My goodness, those muscles are exquisite. I will definitely help a [man/lady] who shows that much dedication to their physique.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Fantastic! Willow said she'd meet you by the entrance, on the west side of Ice Mountain.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Thank you my friend, I will meet you there.
If this was not the last member the player needed to recruit:

steps.player: What an exhausting workout. I hope the others aren't as much effort to recruit.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: If this was the last member the player needed to recruit:

steps.player: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.{{fact}}

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: What did you want me to do again?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: I want you to prove your strength by showing me your muscles!
Show your strength by flexing your muscles.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.player: Do you think you'll be able to handle all these rocks?

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Should not be a problem. This challenge is easy for a [strongman/strongwoman].

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: Do not worry my friend. If you stay dedicated and keep working everyday, you'll be able to achieve anything you dream of.

checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.speaker: Checkal
checkal-the-strongman-talking-to-checkal.text: One last thing - be careful when we go inside. You never know what will happen.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Hey there. Would you happen to be Marley?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: I could be. Depends on who's asking? If you're with the Varrock City Guard, I had nothing to do with the robbery at the museum. I don't even know what I'd do with some Wizard robes.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Uhm, no? What robbery? Wizard robes?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Robbery? Sorry [sir/miss], first I've heard of a robbery.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Look, I'm not here with the city guard, Willow sent me to find you. She needs your help.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Willow? Hmm... I'm afraid I don't recall a Willow.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Are you sure? She said you were old pals.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Nope, I'm sure. Only Willow I know of is a type of tree.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: But, then again, my memory is a bit hazy, due to how hungry I am.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: You're too hungry... to remember your friend?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Yep... been a while since I had a nice hot meal.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Sighs*... would you like me to get you something to eat, to help jog your memory?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Oh what a kind offer! I couldn't say no.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Fine, I'll be back in a...

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Woah woah woah, hold your horses there friend! I can't just eat anything. I have very specific dietary requirements.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Don't be like that! I don't want nothing fancy, just a Steak sandwich from the Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Why don't you go and get one then?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Slight problem there, friend. I've been barred and the chef won't make me another one. Something about stealing from punters. I can't remember...

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Sighs*... Fine. If I go get you this sandwich, will you help Willow?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.text: Of course! Oh, by the way, don't bother with the bartender. Just talk to the chef. Trust me.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley.player: Alright. I'll be back momentarily with your sandwich.

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.text: Have you got the sandwich yet?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.player: I'm still working on it. Where did you say you got them from?

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.text: The Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock. They have the best cook around!

marley-the-thief-talking-to-marley-talki.player: I'll go speak to them, then.

marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.speaker: Bartender
marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.text: What can I do yer for?

options.text: A glass of your finest ale please.
Can you recommend where an adventurer might make his fortune?
Do you know where I can get some good equipment?
Hey, Marley sent me in here for a Steak sandwich.

steps.player: Hey, Marley sent me in here for a Steak sandwich.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: MARLEY?! Don't talk about that sorry state of a person in this establishment!

steps.player: Woah okay, sorry! Forget I ever mentioned him.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: You'd better clear off before I make you.

marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.speaker: Cook
marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.text: What do you want? I'm busy!

options.text: I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?

steps.player: I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Hmm... we don't get many food orders in 'ere. Last person to order one of them was barred for thievin'.

steps.player: Oh... uhm... no. It's for me?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Really?

steps.player: No... it's for Marley...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I knew it! I'm not making another meal for that thievin' git! Clear off.

steps.player: At least tell me why you hate him so much?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I know what it's like, not knowin' where your next meals going to come from, so I let him eat 'ere for free.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: The minute I turn my back, he's caught red-handed trying to pickpocket one of our patrons. We gave him the boot there 'n' then.

steps.player: Well, fair enough, but it's just one sandwich. He's not even in Varrock anymore. He's moved off to Edgeville.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: No chance mate, it's the principle. I won't make food for such a low class criminal...

steps.player: Please, I really need Marley's help and he'll only offer it if I get him a Steak sandwich.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Well, I suppose if I give you the recipe, you can make it yourself.

steps.player: Great! I can't imagine it's that hard to make.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Watch your mouth! Making a Steak sandwich is a delicate art!

steps.player: Sorry! Of course it is. What's the recipe then?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: To start, you need to get some prime beef from a cow. The fields around Lumbridge are a great source. Cook it up - medium rare is perfect. Don't cook it for too long or you'll burn it...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Then, you take some bread. I recommend making it fresh, but to each their own. Slice it in half and slide the beautifully cooked beef between the two halves...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: And hey presto, you've got yourself a delicious, perfectly made Steak sandwich.

steps.player: Wow... is that it? Some beef between a loaf of bread?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: It's harder to make than it sounds! Now get out before I whack you one for being so rude.

options.text: Can you sell me any food?
Can you give me any free food?
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.

marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.speaker: Cook
marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.text: What do you want? I'm busy!

options.text: I forgot the recipe to make a Steak sandwich.

steps.player: I forgot the recipe to make a Steak sandwich.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: For Saradomin's sake! Take some bread, cut it in half and stick some cooked Steak inside, done.

steps.player: Oh yeah, thank you!

options.text: Can you sell me any food?
Can you give me any free food?
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.

marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.speaker: Cook
marley-the-thief-making-the-steak-sandwi.text: What do you want? I'm busy!

options.text: I've managed to make myself a Steak sandwich.

steps.player: I've managed to make myself a Steak sandwich.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Let me take a look at it.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Ha ha ha, you call this a sandwich!?

steps.player: Well, I tried my best...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I'm sure you did. It'll be enough for Marley, anyway.

options.text: Can you sell me any food?
Can you give me any free food?
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.player: Hey Marley. I've managed to get your Steak sandwich.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Ah, just in time for my afternoon snack. Pass it over.
You give the steak sandwich to Marley.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Aaah... not quite as good as the usual, but it hit the spot.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Yes [sir/miss] I am. I'll honour my side of the deal and head off to find Willow.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.player: Finally! You can find her on the west side of Ice Mountain.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: Excellent! I'll be on my way then.
If this was not the last member the player needed to convince:

steps.player: Marley is certainly an interesting character. Hopefully the next team member is more respectable.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley.text: If this was the last member the player needed to convince:

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: Ah, my new favourite chef. Have you got another sandwich for me?

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: Woah! Alright there, calm down. Was only a joke.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.player: I don't find being your errand boy very funny.

marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.speaker: Marley
marley-the-thief-returning-to-marley-tal.text: You need to lighten up a little, my friend.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.player: That's everyone gathered. Interesting company for an archaeologist to keep...

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Shrugs* How many archaeologists do you actually know?

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Exactly. So who are you to judge? Anyway, we're all here and ready to break in... Um, I mean excavate... the entrance.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Are you ready? Who knows what's inside the ruins?

steps.player: I'm ready as I'll ever be. Let's head in.

steps.text: Cutscene begins.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Right, that's everyone gathered. Thank you, [player name], for all your help.

steps.player: Oh it was no pro...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Okay everyone, we've wasted enough time. Let's crack this door open. Burntof, you're up!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Try not to blow the entire mountain up this time...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Yesh ma'am, let'sh get this rock out the way.
Screen fades to black.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Jusht got to plashe thish here...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: ... little bit of dyn-*hic*-amite here...

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: ... and there we go!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Now we light the fushe!
Screen returns to normal.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: What are you doin' standin' there?!

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Everyone'sh ran for cover [lad/lass]. You'd best do the shame.

steps.player: Wait, what?!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Clock'sh ticking [lad/lass]!
The player runs off screen, and the rocks blow up, clearing the way to the ruins.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: That was a tad too explosive I think.

steps.player: My ears are still ringing!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
Screen fades to black.
Checkal sets to work clearing out the rubble...
Screen returns to normal.

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].

steps.player: Try not to die...

steps.text: Cutscene shifts to Marley, inside the ruins.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Hmm...
Marley disables a trap.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: That would have been nasty.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
Marley avoids a tripwire.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Now to disarm it...

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Maybe this will work?

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: That got it!

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
Screen fades to black; the player and everyone are now inside the ruins.

steps.player: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Yaaa*hic*aawn

steps.player: You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.player: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.

steps.player: I don't understand...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Theshe markings look familiar...

steps.player: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: I've sheen thish before...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
Burntof steps on a tile, setting something off.

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: hic* Woops...

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: What was that noise?

steps.speaker: Burntof
steps.text: Uh... it wasn't me!
The ground shakes.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Whats happening?!
The ground stops shaking.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
The rocks by the big doors come to life, becoming an Ancient Guardian.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!

steps.speaker: Checkal
steps.text: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.

steps.speaker: Marley
steps.text: I think we should get out of here, Willow!

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
Screen fades to black and the cutscene ends.

steps.player: I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
I need a little bit more time to prepare.

steps.speaker: Willow
steps.text: Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.

the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.speaker: Willow
the-ruins-of-camdozaal-talking-to-willow.text: Are you finally ready to crack these ruins open?

finishing-up.player: That monster showed up at the perfect time. I would have been toast if Willow and her gang had their chance to attack.
Speaking of which, maybe they left something behind I can salvage some kind of reward from.
Looks like Willow left a bag behind. Maybe there's something in it I could take.

finishing-up.text: A sound of doors opening occurs.

finishing-up.player: What was that noise? Please don't be another rock monster...

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Note
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: The player will automatically speak to Ramarno upon closing the quest completion interface.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: Wow. I honestly didn't expect to see a dwarf in these ruins.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: It's been so long since I've heard another person's voice.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: To be honest, it was all a bit of an accident.
There was a gang of... well, I thought were archaeologists, but it turned out they were grave robbers.
I helped them clear the entrance to these ruins and we worked our way inside, only to wake up a monster! They ran off and left me to defeat it.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: That was one of the guardians of this once great city.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: Yes! Camdozaal, home of the Imcando Dwarves.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: These halls once bustled with life, but that was a long time ago. I'm the only one left now. The name's Ramarno.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: Well Ramarno, I'm [player name], and you have me at a loss for words! I'd have never even imagined there would be a whole city down here.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: Not much of a city anymore, I suppose.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.player: I guess I didn't help with that. Sorry about breaking into your home and killing your guardian.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: We have plenty more. No real harm done. That said, I do think I might have a way for you to make up for it. There'll likely be something in it for you as well.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.speaker: Ramarno
post-quest-dialogue-ramarno.text: My workshop is just north of here. Meet me there and we'll talk further.

post-quest-dialogue-ramarno-using-any-it.text: Ramarno still looks shocked. Perhaps you should talk to him first.

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: So this is where you scampered off to after the monster awoke?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Look [player name], it was a simple misunderstanding, that's all...

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Oh really? You threatening to kill me was just a misunderstanding?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Barely... I had to defeat that monster on my own!
What are you doing out here, anyway?

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.

post-quest-dialogue-willow.speaker: Willow
post-quest-dialogue-willow.text: Plus, we heard there are some sealed tombs in the desert that haven't been touched in hundreds of years...

post-quest-dialogue-willow.player: Ah, of course... scoping out your next grave to rob.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: [player name], I am so glad to see you are safe.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.player: Hello, Checkal. Why didn't you tell me about Willow?

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: I am sorry [player name]. I do respect you and your love for the muscle. But sadly I needed the money. These muscles don't pay the bills on their own.

post-quest-dialogue-checkal.speaker: Checkal
post-quest-dialogue-checkal.text: Please do not let this incident divert you from your path of becoming a [strongman/strongwoman]! I truly believe in you.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.player: How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.player: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!

post-quest-dialogue-burntof.speaker: Burntof
post-quest-dialogue-burntof.text: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.

post-quest-dialogue-marley.speaker: Marley
post-quest-dialogue-marley.text: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?

post-quest-dialogue-marley.speaker: Marley
post-quest-dialogue-marley.text: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...

post-quest-dialogue-marley.player: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.

wqyOMP.player: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.
